{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Filter for completed orders only
df_completed = df[df['status'] == 'completed']

# Convert revenue from string to float: remove commas and cast
df_completed['revenue_numeric'] = df_completed['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Identify QA orders: those with revenue = '999,999.99'
qa_mask = df_completed['revenue'] == '999,999.99'

# Exclude QA orders
df_valid = df_completed[~qa_mask]

# Compute and print the number of valid completed orders
num_valid = len(df_valid)
print(f'Number of valid completed orders: {num_valid}')

# Compute mean revenue on valid completed orders
total_revenue_valid = df_valid['revenue_numeric'].sum()
mean_revenue_valid = total_revenue_valid / num_valid
print(f'Mean revenue of valid completed orders: {mean_revenue_valid}')"}
